title.en: Compute and interpret the coefficient of variation

say.en: Heights in centimetres and weights in kilograms cannot be compared by their standard deviations. Divide by the mean and the units vanish. In this lesson: Compute and interpret the coefficient of variation.
Find the combined mean and S.D. of two groups.

body.en: *Coefficient of variation* (Karl Pearson) $C.V. = \sigma/\bar{x} \times 100$ is the S.D. as a percentage of the mean. It is a relative measure, used to compare the variability, consistency or stability of two or more series. The series with the smaller C.V. is more consistent; the one with the larger C.V. is more variable.
body.kn: ವ್ಯತ್ಯಯನ ಗುಣಾಂಕ C.V. = σ/x̄ × 100. ಇದು ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಅಳತೆ; ಶ್ರೇಣಿಗಳ ಸ್ಥಿರತೆಯನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಕಡಿಮೆ C.V. ಇರುವ ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸ್ಥಿರ; ಹೆಚ್ಚು C.V. ಇರುವದು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಯನಶೀಲ.

say.en: Smaller C.V. = more consistent.
Compare series with different units or means.
Batsman A averages fifty with S.D. fifteen. Batsman B averages forty with S.D. eight.
C V for A is fifteen by fifty times a hundred, thirty percent. For B it is eight by forty times a hundred, twenty percent.
A scores more on average, but B has the smaller C V, so B is the more consistent batsman.
To combine two groups, find the combined mean, then add each group's variance and its squared distance from that mean.

body.en: For two groups of sizes $n_1, n_2$ with means $\bar{x}_1, \bar{x}_2$ and S.D.s $\sigma_1, \sigma_2$: *combined mean* $\bar{x}_{12} = (n_1\bar{x}_1 + n_2\bar{x}_2)/(n_1 + n_2)$ and $\sigma_{12}^2 = [n_1(\sigma_1^2 + d_1^2) + n_2(\sigma_2^2 + d_2^2)]/(n_1 + n_2)$, where $d_i = \bar{x}_i - \bar{x}_{12}$.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂). ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ = [n₁(σ₁² + d₁²) + n₂(σ₂² + d₂²)]/(n₁ + n₂), ಇಲ್ಲಿ dᵢ = x̄ᵢ − ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ.

points.en: d₁, d₂ are distances of group means from the *combined mean*
If the means are equal, d₁ = d₂ = 0

narration.en: For two groups of sizes n_1, n_2 with means \bar{x}_1, \bar{x}_2 and S.D.s \sigma_1, \sigma_2: combined mean \bar{x}_{12} = (n_1\bar{x}_1 + n_2\bar{x}_2)/(n_1 + n_2) and \sigma_{12}^2 = [n_1(\sigma_1^2 + d_1^2) + n_2(\sigma_2^2 + d_2^2)]/(n_1 + n_2), where d_i = \bar{x}_i - \bar{x}_{12}.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ = (n₁x̄₁ + n₂x̄₂)/(n₁ + n₂). ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ = [n₁(σ₁² + d₁²) + n₂(σ₂² + d₂²)]/(n₁ + n₂), ಇಲ್ಲಿ dᵢ = x̄ᵢ − ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ.

say.en: For two groups of sizes n 1, n 2 with means \bar{x}_1, \bar{x}_2 and S.D.s \sigma 1, \sigma 2: combined mean \bar{x} 12 equals (n 1\bar{x}_1 plus n 2\bar{x}_2)/n 1 plus n 2 and \sigma 12 to the power 2 = [n 1(\sigma 1 to the power 2 plus d 1 to the power 2) plus n 2(\sigma 2 to the power 2 plus d 2 to the power 2)]/n 1 plus n 2, where d i = \bar{x}_i - \bar{x} 12. d 1, d 2 are distances of group means from the combined mean.
say.kn: ಎರಡು ಗುಂಪುಗಳ ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ = (n 1x̄ 1 plus n 2x̄ 2)/n 1 plus n 2. ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸಾಂಕ = [n 1(sigma 1 squared plus d 1 squared) plus n 2(sigma 2 squared plus d 2 squared)]/n 1 plus n 2, ಇಲ್ಲಿ d i equals x̄ i - ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಸರಾಸರಿ.

problem.en: Batsman A: mean 50, S.D. 15. Batsman B: mean 40, S.D. 8. Who is more consistent?

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Batsman A: mean 50, S.D. 15. Batsman B: mean 40, S.D. 8. Who is more consistent?

say.en: Let us work this out together. Batsman A: mean 50, S.D. 15. Batsman B: mean 40, S.D. 8. Who is more consistent?
C.V.A equals 15 over 50 times 100 equals 30 percent.
C.V.B equals 8 over 40 times 100 equals 20 percent.
B has the smaller C.V.
So the answer is B is more consistent.

problem.en: Group 1: n = 40, mean 50, S.D. 6. Group 2: n = 60, mean 45, S.D. 8. Find the combined mean and S.D.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Group 1: n = 40, mean 50, S.D. 6. Group 2: n = 60, mean 45, S.D. 8. Find the combined mean and S.D.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Group 1: n equals 40, mean 50, S.D. 6. Group 2: n equals 60, mean 45, S.D. 8. Find the combined mean and S.D.
x̄ 12 equals (40 times 50 plus 60 times 45)/100 equals 4700 over 100 equals 47.
d 1 equals 50 minus 47 equals 3; d 2 equals 45 minus 47 equals minus 2.
sigma squared = [4036 plus 9 plus 6064 plus 4]/100 equals 1800 plus 4080/100 equals 58.8.
sigma equals the square root of 58.8 equals 7.67.
So the answer is Combined mean equals 47; combined S.D. = 7.67.

body.en: C.V. measures wobble per unit of average. The lower the C.V., the steadier the series: consistent, uniform, stable, homogeneous all mean the same.
